camera.reason: Single 50MP main camera without OIS and a weak 5MP selfie camera.

performance.reason: Unisoc T7250 with eMMC 5.1 storage is the slowest chip in the bracket.

battery.reason: 8,000mAh with 45W charging, the biggest battery in the bracket, lasts two days.

display.reason: HD+ IPS LCD at 120Hz with 900 nits in high brightness mode.

build.reason: Plastic body with IP64, a 2m drop rating and MIL-STD-810H claims.

software.reason: realme has not published a C100x policy; 2 OS updates and 3 years of patches assumed from realme's minimum.

value.reason: The 8,000mAh battery is the only standout; an entry chip, HD+ LCD and no NFC at 67,500 lose to most rivals.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye in both colours with official realme warranty.

notes: Only PriceOye was checked for stock; the 8GB 128GB was in stock only in Deepblue Tides. WhatMobile shows the official price as 69,999. Pakistan units lack NFC per WhatMobile. The update policy is assumed.
